book.title: Lijambu la Amboni ngati ejuandiki Yohana

content: Yesu bumpaki mauta gaganungali ku Betania
Pagahigali masoba sita kabula jukuhika tipati ja Pasaka, Yesu jwahika ku Betania kojwabia jutama Lazalu joanhyoa.
Kokuje buntelakiya posu ja pakamii, na Maluta jwabia jutenda kwaatelake. Lazalu jwabi kati ja bandu bababi pamu na Yesu.
Malia jwajukua mahuta gaganungi ga bei ngolongu nusu lita galenganaki kunkongu gobugukema nado, nukumpaki Yesu mumagolu nukunhungu kwa majunzu gaki. Nyumba joti jatweli ulumba wa mahuta gaganungi.
Henu, ntumi waka Yesu jumu, jobunkema Yuda Isikalioti, joanng'anambuka Yesu, jwapwaga,
“Mbanga mahuta gabei ngolongu aga bakalombisa hipati mia tatu ya feza, nakaapeke aka kapuko?”
Jwapwaga hela, si japala kwaajangati aka kapuku, ila ndaba jabii mwii. Ndaba jukubika jubeka mpuku ulupija, kila mala jwabia jujiba lupija mumpuku gola.
Yesu jwapwaga, “Mundeka, jagalomba mahuta ge haga ili jagabeka lisoba luku ndaga nepani.
Aka kapuku mwikuba nabu masoba goti, lakini nga mwikubi nanepani masoba gote.”
Ayaudi ajetangakane kunkoma Lazalu
Ayaudi bingi bajogwini Yesu jubii ku Betania. Ndi bahika kola nga ndaba jukumbona pee Yesu, ila kabee bapala kumbona Lazalu joanhyoha Yesu.
Agolu akolongu nabombi bajetanganiya kabee kunkoma Lazalu,
ndaba jukuyoka kwaka Lazalu, Ayaudi bingi baakana aka kilongosi babu, nukunhobale Yesu.
Yesu jujingi ku Yelusalemu sukutogule ngani
Kilabu jaki, bandu bingi bababiya ahikiki ku tipati ja Pasaka bajogwana Yesu jubi mwindela kuhika ku Yelusalemu.

Ndienu bajukuwa mambandi gi mikongu gabagakema mitendi, koni bajenda kunzopa Yesu bakajamaliya kwa sauti ngolongu bakapwaga, “Julumbalikaa Sapanga! Jupengalika hajo jojuika kupete liina laka Bambu. Julumbalika Bambu nkolongu juku Izilaeli.”
Yesu japata liponda, julikwelalia panani jaki ngati hegapwaga Maandiku ga Sapi.
“Mwijogopa mwa bandu buku Sayuni!

content.text: Lingalya Bambu nkolongu wino jutenda kuhika,

content: Banafunzi baki ngasebaheliwi majambu ge gala, lakini Yesu pajayoka nukupata ukolongu, ndi pabakombuka ganigala gabi gaandikwi kundongale jombi bandu bahenga hela ndaba jaki.
Bandu bababi pamu na Yesu kipindi paankema Lazalu kuhuma mulitenge, nukunhyoha, baalandila bandu majambu gala gagapiti.
Henu bandu bingi bajenda kunzopa, ndaba boka babi ajogwini jutei nginyuli ye hehi.
Henu, Afalisayu bapwaganiya, “Boo mumbwene? Ngatuwesi kutenda sokape! Lingalia, Bandu boka bupundema batenda kumpwata.”
Agiliki bangi apala kumbona Yesu
Babii Agiliki bangi kati ja bandu bababia ahikiki ku Yelusalemu kunndumbali Sapanga kipindi sukutogule Pasaka sela.
Bunzendila Pilipi, mwenei juku Betisaida ku Galilaya kola, bumpwagila, “Nkolongoo, twaa tupala kumbona Yesu.”
Pilipi jwajenda kumpwagi Andilea na boka abeli bajenda kumpwagi Yesu.
Yesu jwaapwagila, “Lisaa lihikiki Mwana waka Mundu kumpeke ukolongu!
Numpwagi sakaka, imbeju jimu ji inganu jiigali pee kuba imbeju jimu ngati ejabii, lakini na jiabwiki pai nakuwa jitenda kumela, nukupapa imbeju hingi.
Jojupala womi waki punndema pani jwitenda kuguhoa, lakini jwanga kugupala womi waki punndema pani, jwagubeka mbaka pajwipata womi wa masoba goti.
Jojupala kundumaki nepani lasima jumbwata neepani, pokapi pamii nepani ndi nuntumisi wangu pajwiibia. Mundu jokapi jojundumaki neepani Atati bangu biitenda kundenda.”
Yesu julongale kuwa kwaki
“Henu moju wangu gubina ngamaa, henu mbwaga kike? Boo, mbwaga lee, ‘Atati nhokula kipindi senze lakini hikiki ndaba jikipindi senze?’ Lakini ne nhikiki ndaba mbetila kipindi senze.
Atati, ulangia ukolongu waku.” Ndi sauti jajogwanika kuhuma kunani kwaka Sapanga, “Nangi ukolongu wangu na nilangia kabee.”
Bandu bingi bababiya ajemiki pala bajogwa sauti jela, na bangi bapwaga, “Senesi lee kitobe.” Lakini bangi bapwaga, “Ntumi jukunani kwaka Sapanga jutei kulonge naku!”
Lakini Yesu jwaapwagila, “Sauti heji ngasejahikiki ndaba jangu nepani, ila ndaba jinu mwanganya.
Sajenu ndi muda wa bandu bupunndema goni kutemuliwa, henu lijobi jojuwe nkolongu ja ndema jenu ajenda kumboa.
Nepani pabiingwea kunani junndema nanhuta kila mundu kuhika kwangu.”
Kupwaaga kwaki hela, kwalangia kuwa kwaki kuibiya boo.

Nsambi wa bandu gola gwapwaga, “Twepani Malagalaki jitu jitupwagi Kilisitu nkombosi jwitama yaka petapeta. Henu uwesa boo kupwaga eti Mwana waka Mundu biitenda kunkwea kunani? Kilisitu wee hoju nyane?”
Yesu jwapwaga, “Unang'anu wakona gubi na mwanganya kwa kipindi kijipi. Nzendanya pagubii unang'anu hogu ili lwii lwampata, ndaba jojujenda mu lwii ngasejukumanya kojujenda.
Henu hembii na unang'anu hogu muguhobalya unang'anu ili mmbia mwabandu bu unang'anu.” Ayaudi akana kuhobale Yesu Yesu hejwajomula kulonge, jwaboka nukujenda kujoba kutali nunsambi wa bandu gola.
Yesu pamu nukutenda ndonduke yoka yela pa bandu lakini bombi ngase bunhobalile.
Ndi malobi gajwapwaga Isaya jojabii mlota waka Sapanga gatenda kutimi,

content.text: Boo na makili gaka Sapanga gabonikini kwaka nyane?”

content: Ndi, ngasebawesa kuhobale, ndaba Isaya jwapwagiki kabee pandu pangi.
“Sapanga jwatei abiya bangalinga,
Isaya jojabii mlota waka Sapanga jwapwaga malobi haga ndaba jugubweni ukolongu waka Yesu, ndi jalandila majambu gaki.
Hata hela, aka kilongosi bingi ba Ayaudi bunhobali Yesu. Lakini ndaba jaaka Afalisayu, ngase bunzetaki palongi ja bandu ndaba jukujogopa kwaatumi mu Manyumba jukuketangane Ayaudi.
Bapai kulumbaliwa na bandu kuliku kulumbaliwa na Sapanga.
Malobi gaka Yesu ndi gaatemula bandu
Ndi Yesu jwapwagiki kwa sauti ngolongu, “Mundu jojunhobale nepani, ngase junhobale nepani pee, ila anhobalee kabee najojundumiki nepani.
Mundu jojumona nepani ambona kabee na jojundumiki nepani.
Nepani nunang'anu, nanepani nhikiki pundema ili miya nunang'anu ili boka ba anhobalee nepani biigali kulwii.
Jojugajogwane malobi gangu lakini ngase jugakamu, nepani nga nunhukumo. Ndaba ngasenahika kutemu bandu bupu nndema pani ila kwaaokoa.
Jwanga kugakamu malobi gangu jubii juku ntemula. Lilobi lee lenumpwaji ndi lukutemula lisoba la mwiso.
Nepani ngase napwagiki ku uwesu wangu na mwete, ila Atati ba andumiki ndi babambwagila mbwaga kii na nongila kii.
Nepani manyiki miilu jaki jileta womi wama soba goka. Henu, nembwaga pee ga anagalaki Atati kugapwaga.”
